headline: 🔴 Download More RAM breaks VBS/HVCI, 🛢️ Shell probes Clop's 89GB claim, 🔑 Entra ID makes passkeys default, 💎 Ruby Marshal.load RCE chain, 💰 TheGentlemen posts 7 victims, 📟 NHS pager breach admitted
summary: Researchers disclosed a software-only attack that aliases DRAM via SPD writes to bypass Windows VBS and HVCI and disable Defender, while Shell investigates Clop's claim of an 89GB theft and Microsoft makes passkeys the Entra ID default ahead of retiring SMS and voice MFA. ZDI published an unpatched signature bypass in PAX Q80 payment terminals, the LiteLLM exfiltration archive is quantified at 153GB across 2,488 corporate domains, and the leak-site pace keeps up with TheGentlemen, Storm, Carhartt, and Zebra claims.
